Find Your Balance

Welcome to Lotus & Light Yoga Studio, a warm and welcoming space in the heart of Maple Grove where breath, movement, and community meet. Whether you're stepping onto the mat for the first time or deepening a lifelong practice, we have a class for you.

Sign Up for a Class

Why Practice With Us

Our studio was founded on the belief that yoga should be accessible, restorative, and genuinely joyful. Here's what makes Lotus & Light different.

Experienced Teachers

Our instructors bring decades of combined experience in Hatha, Vinyasa, and restorative traditions, each certified at the 500-hour level or beyond.

All Levels Welcome

From your very first downward dog to advanced arm balances, every class is taught with modifications so you can practice at your own pace.

A Peaceful Space

Our light-filled studio features heated floors, soft natural textiles, and a small courtyard garden for quiet reflection before and after class.

Weekly Class Schedule

Classes run seven days a week. Arrive 10 minutes early to settle in and grab a mat if you need one.

Lotus & Light Studio — Spring Schedule
Day Time Class Instructor

Monday 6:00 PM Gentle Hatha David Ortiz

Wednesday 6:30 AM Power Flow Maria Chen
Wednesday 7:00 PM Candlelight Yin David Ortiz
Thursday 9:00 AM Prenatal Yoga Priya Nair
Friday 6:00 PM Slow Flow & Meditation Maria Chen
Saturday 10:00 AM Community Vinyasa David Ortiz
Sunday 11:00 AM Gentle Stretch & Tea Priya Nair

Membership & Pricing

Choose the option that fits your practice. All memberships include access to our mat and prop library.

Drop-In

$22 / class

Perfect for visitors or anyone wanting to try a single class without commitment.

Monthly Unlimited

$95 / month

Unlimited classes, priority booking, and 10% off workshops and retreats. Our most popular plan.

10-Class Pass

$180 / pass

Great for flexible schedules. Passes never expire and can be shared with a friend or family member.

What Our Students Say

"Lotus & Light has become my Sunday ritual. I leave every class feeling lighter and more grounded."

— Emily R., member since 2021

"As a complete beginner I was nervous, but the teachers made me feel at home from day one."

— James K., member since 2023

"The prenatal class was exactly what I needed during my pregnancy. Gentle, safe, and so supportive."

— Sofia M., member since 2022

Sign Up for a Class

Fill out the form below and a member of our team will reach out within one business day to confirm your spot and answer any questions.
